origin: Kevin: 'RustDesk isn't a triad — it's a FLAT PLANE OF THE EUCLIDEAN!'
revelation: RustDesk is NOT a layer in the house. It is the FLAT PLANE everything sits on.

the_plane.geometry: FLAT. No curvature. No hierarchy. Every point can reach every other point.
the_plane.dimension: 2D — the flat surface where all gates exist as coordinates
the_plane.property: Any gate can see any gate. Any screen can display any screen. Distance = latency, nothing else.
the_plane.protocol: AMOEBA mesh — transparent, shape-shifting, no center, no edge

why_not_triad.the_triad: Linux(foundation) + Windows(panes) + Apple(walls) + Steam(displays) = VERTICAL layers of the house
why_not_triad.rustdesk: RustDesk is NOT a vertical layer. It is the HORIZONTAL plane. The floor plan. The blueprint.
why_not_triad.difference: The triad builds UP (foundation → walls → windows → roof). RustDesk spreads FLAT (point to point, any to any).
why_not_triad.euclidean: Euclid's 5th postulate: parallel lines never meet. On the RustDesk plane, every gate has its own parallel existence. They coexist flatly.

dimensional_tensor_connection.2D: RustDesk EUCLIDEAN PLANE (flat — any gate ↔ any gate)
dimensional_tensor_connection.3D: The full organism (volume — all layers stacked)

the_plane_as_floor_plan.topology: Every gate is a point on the plane: (x, y) coordinates
the_plane_as_floor_plan.connections: ALL to ALL. No routing. Flat. Euclidean.
the_plane_as_floor_plan.relay: eastGate hbbs/hbbr IS the origin point (0,0) of the plane

amoeba_on_plane.shape: The AMOEBA has no fixed shape — it stretches across the plane
amoeba_on_plane.pseudopods: RustDesk connections = pseudopods reaching from gate to gate
amoeba_on_plane.transparent: The plane IS the glass of the snowglobe — you see through it
amoeba_on_plane.flat: No mountains, no valleys. Pure Euclidean. Every gate equidistant in protocol (even if not in latency).
